title: 第五章 外来势力第六章 借刀杀人
lines: 第五章：外来势力
只见那少年刚想伸手揭开沈玥的面纱，却被沈玥的一个闪身给躲了开去。看着偏向一侧的沈玥，华衣少年双眼闪过一丝恼怒。随即只见其双脚一蹬，如苍鹰搏兔一般袭向沈玥。
“本少爷想要的东西，还没有要不到的，看招！”，被沈玥再次拦下的少年，却是恼怒的再次出手道。
在少年再次出手的时候，一名跟随少年而来的青衣大汉，也是瞬时出掌，向沈玥后背袭来。随即只见沈玥一个弯腰，躲过了大汉这必中的一击，但也被其袭来的掌风，吹落了面纱。
看到沈玥落下的面纱，华衣少年大笑道：“黎叔做的好！小娘皮，至今，还没有本少爷做不到的事，得不到的东西，你也不例外！”。
闻言，弯腰而起的沈玥，眼中精光一闪。随即只见其双腿一屈，身子向前一倾，向着华衣少年奔去。在沈玥起身的瞬间，只见其右腿一伸，脚掌向着华服少年的跨下踢去。
随即只听到“碰”的一声，在众人的耳旁响起。在场的男性，顿时只感到胯下一痛，一股嗖嗖的寒意，从心底升起，“这小姑娘，太狠了！”。
伴随着华服少年一声杀猪般的惨叫，沈玥却是娇笑道：“敢惹本姑娘的，从来都没有好果子吃，你也不例外！”。
“臭婊.子，给脸不要脸，敢踢老子。老子要杀了你全家，把你卖到窑子里，让你成为那万人骑的最肮脏的贱货！”。
忍着胯下的剧痛，华衣少年恶狠狠的命令道：“黎叔，给我拿下那贱货！”。
闻言，青衣大汉看了一眼脸色酱红，面目狰狞的华衣少年，点了点头。随即双掌变爪，向沈玥抓去。
正在此时，刚刚趋步赶来的叶重，身如轻燕般一个翻身滑步，落立在沈玥的身后。双手使出八卦掌中，龙相雷属性的“震”字决。
看着这忽然冒出的白衣少年，青衣大汉咧嘴一笑：“小子，别英雄救美不成，反而搭上了自己的小命。”。
随着一道狰狞的笑声，只见青衣大汉瞬时变爪为拳，与叶重的手掌，重重的对撞在了一起。
“轰”，一股气波，在叶重与青衣大汉之间瞬时破碎了开来，随着叶重二人“蹬蹬”的后退，带起阵阵烟尘。
“武师强者！”，后退了五步，忍住体内翻滚的气血，叶重沉声道。
“一个连元气外放，都做不到的小子，怎么会这么强！”，看着地面上自己留下的两个脚印，青衣大汉却是低声惊呼道。
看到这一幕，华衣少年气急败坏的道：“都给我上，将这个不知天高地厚的臭小子，和那个杀千刀的臭婆娘，都给我抓下。敢在太岁头上动土，老子看你有几条命！”。
还不等华衣少年的人有所行动，沈威就带着十几名大卖场的护卫，将华衣少年一群人给围了起来：“妈的，敢在我天鹰堡的地盘捣乱，活得不耐烦了吗？重少爷，玥小姐，你们没事吧！”。
安抚好叶重二人，沈威气急败坏的下令道：“来人，给我把这群不长眼的东西，都给我拿下。敢在我天鹰堡的地盘，欺负我天鹰堡的人，不想活了！”。
心中却是暗骂道：“老子才接手这护卫队长一职，正好表少爷与小姐来，本想好好表现一番，却出这档子事。你们这群混蛋，不想让老子好过，你们也别想好过！”。
闻言，拔出武器的护卫皆是应和道：“是，队长！”。
看着向自己等人逼近的护卫，华衣少年却是冷声道：“尹框，你不是说着天水城，是你尹家的地盘，你们尹家说了算吗？我受你父亲的邀请，来这天水城做客，却被人欺负成这样，这就是你尹家的待客之道吗？”。
看着华衣少年目光所盯着的那名紫衣少年，沈威却是苦着脸低声道：“少城主，尹框！他怎么在这，看来这件事，不是那么容易解决的了！”。
紫衣少年扫了一眼叶重，随后微笑着对华衣少年轻声道：“少殿主，还请稍安勿躁，这件事我来解决！”。
“哼，尹框，如果你尹家想要和我药皇殿合作的话，最好处理好这件事。我要杀了这个白衣小子，至于这位姑娘吗，今晚我要让她侍寝！”，华衣少年扫了一眼脸色发白的叶重，随即眼神火热的盯着沈玥，冷声道。
一想到沈玥在自己身下承欢的场景，华衣少年的心情就是一阵愉快，“没想到，在天水城这种破地方，还有如此水灵的美人！”。
盯着华衣少年看了一眼，叶重声音低沉的自语道：“药皇殿？名字挺霸气，难道是外来势力？看其跋扈的模样，恐怕就连城主府都忌惮不已！”。
看着缓缓而来的紫衣少年，沈威却是沉声道：“少城主！这二位是我天鹰堡的重少爷和玥小姐。如果您想拿下他们，给这位少爷撒气的话，那就是与我天鹰堡开战。我相信城主府，还没有这个实力和底气吧！”
顿了顿，定了定心神，沈威接着沉声说道：“望少城主三思！”。

Chapter 5: External forces
The young man was about to reach out and lift Shen Yue's veil, but was dodged by Shen Yue's move. Looking at Shen Yue who was leaning to one side, a hint of anger flashed in the eyes of the young man in Chinese clothes. Immediately, he kicked off his feet and attacked Shen Yue like an eagle attacking a rabbit.
"There is nothing that this young master wants that cannot be obtained. Let's see what the moves are!" The young man who was stopped by Shen Yue again said angrily and took action again.
When the boy took action again, a big man in green clothes who followed the boy also instantly struck at Shen Yue's back with his palm. Immediately, Shen Yue bent down to avoid the big man's inevitable blow, but was blown off by the wind from his palm.
Seeing Shen Yue's veil falling, the young man in Chinese clothes laughed and said, "Uncle Li, well done! My dear, till now, there is nothing that I can't do, and there is nothing that I can't get, and you are no exception!".
Hearing this, Shen Yue stood up with a flash of light in her eyes. Immediately, his legs were bent, his body leaned forward, and he ran towards the young man in colorful clothes. The moment Shen Yue stood up, he stretched out his right leg and kicked the young man in rich clothes with the sole of his foot.
Then there was only a "touch" sound, which sounded in everyone's ears. The men present suddenly felt pain in their crotches, and a chill rose from the bottom of their hearts, "This little girl is so cruel!".
As the young man in rich clothes screamed like a slaughtering pig, Shen Yue said with a sweet smile: "Anyone who dares to mess with this girl will never get good results, and you are no exception!".
"You bitch, you are so shameless that you dare to kick me. I will kill your whole family, sell you to a brothel, and make you the filthiest bitch among thousands of people!".
Enduring the severe pain in his crotch, the young man in colorful clothes ordered fiercely: "Uncle Li, get that bitch for me!".
Hearing this, the man in green clothes glanced at the young man in Chinese clothes with a red face and a ferocious face, and nodded. Then his palms turned into claws and he grabbed at Shen Yue.
At this moment, Ye Zhong, who had just arrived, turned over and slid like a light swallow, landing behind Shen Yue. Use both hands to use the "Zhen" word Jue with the attribute of Long Xiang Lei in Ba Gua Zhang.
Looking at the young man in white who suddenly appeared, the big man in green grinned: "Boy, if a hero fails to save a beauty, he ends up taking his own life instead."
With a ferocious laugh, the big man in green clothes instantly turned his claws into fists, and collided heavily with Ye Zhong's palm.
"Boom", a wave of air instantly shattered between Ye Zhong and the big man in Tsing Yi, and as Ye Zhong and the two retreated with a "kick", it brought up bursts of smoke and dust.
"Strong martial artist!" Ye Zhong said solemnly, taking five steps back and holding back the blood boiling in his body.
"How can a kid who can't even release his energy be so strong!" Looking at the two footprints he left on the ground, the man in green exclaimed in a low voice.
Seeing this scene, the young man in colorful clothes said angrily: "Come here, catch this stinky boy who doesn't know the heights of heaven and earth, and that stinky woman who has killed a thousand swords. If you dare to disturb Tai Sui, I will see how much life you have!".
Before the people of the colorfully clothed boy could take action, Shen Wei led a dozen or so hypermarket guards and surrounded the group of the colorfully clothed boy: "Damn it, you dare to cause trouble in my territory of Tianying Castle, are you tired of living? Master Zhong, Miss Yue, are you okay!".
After appeasing Ye Zhong and the other two, Shen Wei angrily ordered: "Come here, take down all these blind people. Anyone who dares to bully my Sky Eagle Castle in my territory of Sky Eagle Castle, I don't want to live anymore!".
But he cursed secretly in his heart: "I just took over the position of captain of the guard, and it happened that the young master and the young lady were here. I wanted to show off well, but something like this happened. You bastards, if you don't want me to have an easy time, you don't want to have an easy time either!"
Hearing this, the guards who drew their weapons responded and said, "Yes, Captain!".
Looking at the guards approaching him and others, the young man in colorful clothes said coldly: "Yin frame, didn't you say that Tianshui City is the territory of your Yin family, and your Yin family has the final say? I was invited by your father to come to Tianshui City as a guest, but I was bullied like this. Is this the way your Yin family treats guests?"
Looking at the young man in purple who was staring at the young man in colorful clothes, Shen Wei said in a low voice with a grimace: "Young City Lord, Yin Jian! Why is he here? It seems that this matter is not so easy to solve!".
The young man in purple glanced at Ye Zhong, then smiled and said softly to the young man in Chinese clothes: "Young Master, please be patient, I will handle this matter!".
"Humph, Yin Jiang, if your Yin family wants to cooperate with my Medicine Emperor Palace, you'd better handle this matter. I'm going to kill this boy in white. As for this girl, I want her to sleep with her tonight!" The young man in rich clothes glanced at Ye Zhong, who was pale, and then stared at Shen Yue with fiery eyes and said coldly.
Thinking of the scene of Shen Yue enjoying herself under him, the young man in Chinese clothes felt happy, "I didn't expect that in a shabby place like Tianshui City, there would be such a beautiful woman!".
After staring at the young man in colorful clothes, Ye Zhong said to himself in a low voice: "Yaohuang Palace? The name is quite domineering. Is it an external force? Judging from its domineering appearance, even the city lord's palace may be afraid of it!".
Looking at the purple-clothed young man slowly approaching, Shen Wei said in a deep voice: "Young City Lord! These two are the important young master and Miss Yue of our Sky Eagle Castle. If you want to capture them and make this young master angry, then you have to start a war with my Sky Eagle Castle. I believe that the City Lord's Mansion does not have the strength and confidence yet!"
After a pause to calm down, Shen Wei then said in a deep voice: "I hope the Young Master will think twice!".
